title: Types removal in 8.0

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

labels.name: Team:Search Foundations
labels.description: Meta label for the Search Foundations team in Elasticsearch

body:
This is a meta issue that tracks things that must or should be done before 8.0 in order to finalize the removal of types.

Remaining:
* [x] REST-layer version compatibility
* [x] Rewrite `Removal of Types` doc to point to 7x branch https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/53670
* [x] Master nodes should refuse to join a cluster with multi-typed index templates #53018 
* [ ] Test rolling upgrades from 7x with typed mappings and templates #48800
* [x] Remove ability to reference `_type` in scripts via `LeafDocLookup` https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/53605
* [x] Add deprecation warning to `TermsLookup#parseTermsLookup()` in 7x when type is included https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/53731
* [x] Remove TypeFieldMapper

Longer term:
 * [ ] Merge back FieldMapper and MappedFieldType (issue: #41058)
 * [ ] Remove `String type` parameter from all internal code, eg. `MapperService`.

**MUST**
 * [x] Remove typed URL paths
    * [x] RestNoopBulkAction @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46668)
    * [x] RestNoopSearchAction @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46668)
    * [x] RestMultiSearchTemplateAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41640)
    * [x] RestSearchTemplateAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41640)
    * [x] RestDeleteByQueryAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41640)
    * [x] RestUpdateByQueryAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41640)
    * [x] RestGetFieldMappingAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41676)
    * [x] RestGetMappingAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41676)
    * [x] RestPutMappingAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41676)
    * [x] RestValidateQueryAction @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46927)
    * [x] RestBulkAction @romseygeek (#46983)
    * [x] RestDeleteAction @romseygeek (#47671)
    * [x] RestGetAction @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46587)
    * [x] RestGetSourceAction @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46931)
    * [x] RestIndexAction @romseygeek (#47671)
    * [x] RestMultiGetAction @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46587)
    * [x] RestMultiTermVectorsAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41640)
    * [x] RestTermVectorsAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41640)
    * [x] RestUpdateAction @romseygeek (#47671)
    * [x] RestCountAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42112)
    * [x] RestExplainAction @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46926)
    * [x] RestMultiSearchAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41640)
    * [x] RestSearchAction @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41640)
    * [x] RestGraphAction @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46935)
    * [x] RestSimulatePipelineAction @romseygeek #50131
 * [x] Remove types from Request objects
    * [x] SearchRequest @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42112)
        *  [x] QueryShardContext @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42112)
    * [x] TermVectorsRequest @colings86 (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42198)
    * [x] ValidateQueryRequest @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46927)
    * [x] ExplainRequest @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46926)
    * [x] RoutingMissingException @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46587)
 * [x] Remove types from the query DSL
    * [x] AbstractGeometryQueryBuilder @romseygeek (#47792)
    * [x] TermsQueryBuilder @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46943)
    * [x] PercolateQueryBuilder @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46985)
 * [x] Remove support for `include_type_name` in index creation, mapping and template APIs. #48632 
 * [x] Remove type parameters from the node client
    * [x] prepareIndex()
    * [x] prepareDelete()
    * [x] prepareUpdate()
    * [x] PutMappingRequest
 * [x] Remove `_type` from GET responses @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46587)
 * [x] Remove `_type` from `_search` responses. @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46942)
 * [x] Remove searches on the `_type` field (e.g. in terms lookup and percolator queries)
   * [x] Remove `type` query https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/47207
   * [x] Disallow using the `_type` field in queries (such as `term` and `wildcard`). (#51100)
 * [x] Remove types from watcher's `IndexAction` (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/47986)
 * [x] Remove types from WatcherSearchTemplateRequest. (#51112)
 * [x] Remove deprecated typed methods on the high-level REST client. #48471 

**SHOULD**
 * [x] Remove types from `TermsLookup` @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/46943)
 * [x] Remove type from `SourceToParse` (#47229)
 * [x] Remove types from `IndexShard.applyXOperation` methods (#52977 

 * [x] Remove code that is related to the `_default_` mapping. @romseygeek (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/44945)
 * [x] Remove the `_type` mapping field? (#51100)
 * [x] InternalIndexingStats only needs one stats instance https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/47203

**KNOWN BUGS/ TRAPS**
* Index creation and put template requests can accept malformed mappings: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/38266
